```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
```

# Dataset on Net Attendance Rate
```{r}
primary_net_attendance_rate <- read_xlsx("../Data/Adjusted_net_attendance_rate_2022_formatted.xlsx", sheet= "Primary", skip = 1) |>
  rename( "ISO" = `...1`,
         "Country" = `...2`,
         "SubRegion" = `...3`,
         "Development" = `...5`,
         "Total Completion" = `...6` 
) |> clean_names()
LowerSecondary_net_attendance_rate <- read_xlsx("../Data/Adjusted_net_attendance_rate_2022_formatted.xlsx", sheet= "Lower secondary", skip = 1) |>
  rename( "ISO" = `...1`,
         "Country" = `...2`,
         "SubRegion" = `...3`,
         "Development" = `...5`,
         "Total Completion" = `...6` 
)|> clean_names()
UpperSecondary_net_attendance_rate <- read_xlsx("../Data/Adjusted_net_attendance_rate_2022_formatted.xlsx", sheet= "Upper secondary", skip = 1) |>
  rename( "ISO" = `...1`,
         "Country" = `...2`,
         "SubRegion" = `...3`,
         "Development" = `...5`,
         "Total Completion" = `...6` 
) |> clean_names()
```

# Dataset on Foundational Learning
```{r}
combined_foundational_edu <- read_xlsx("../Data/Foundational-learning-2022-formatted.xlsx", , sheet= "Combined", skip = 1) |>
  rename(
          "Countries_Areas" = `...1`,
         "Region" = `...2`,
         "SubRegion" = `...3`,
         "Development" = `...4`,
         "Age_Group" = `...5`,
         "Subject" = `...6`,
         "Total" = `...7`
)
```
